about_the_game:
Our Eyes See No Evil is a first-person horror game that can use a player's webcam in order to detect when their eyes are opened or closed.

In a suffocating world, you prefer to stay inside. But when your home becomes haunted by a mysterious clown doll, your refuge slowly becomes corrupted, and you find you must either confront the horrors—or close your eyes.

Closing the player’s eyes provides safety from the terror, but also leaves them vulnerable to the unknown. Closing your Eyes also improves your sense of hearing, giving you the ability to focus on sounds far away. 

This mechanic twists the classic horror trope of "Don't look at the monster" into a terrifying choice: how long can you stand to not look?

The player must push through a constant sense of unease and tension in a familiar environment in order to progress. By merging the player’s real-world eye movements with psychological horror, Our Eyes See No Evil delivers an immersive and terrifying experience unlike anything before.

  • Survive through the night as the clown haunts you.

  • Close your Eyes to hide from it.

  • Explore your house and use your hearing skills to inspect sounds and unravel the mystery behind the clown.
